shared_elements: possible faint carved/incised marking on a stone surface
justification: B depicts a clear figural relief scheme — profile human figures in patterned headdresses with weapons and a horse's head above a lower band of rosettes — while A shows essentially no legible iconography, only weathered boulders on a grassy slope with at most an ambiguous shallow marking. There is no shared motif, relationship or arrangement beyond the bare fact that both are worked/marked stone surfaces, which counts for nothing iconographically.
